The firm entered at the $100M Series A of November 2025 (the firm's 'why we invested' post of that month) and led the Series B of March 2026. | A/B pass (2026-09-26), entry round cited: the firm took part in the Series A of 2025-11: 'Israeli AI agent startup Wonderful has raised $100 million in a Series A round led by Index Ventures, with participation from Insight Partners, IVP, Bessemer, and Vine Ventures.' | Country cited: the company's Series B release is datelined Amsterdam (2026-03-12).

wonderskin.note: Wonderskin, cosmetics brand. The firm's investment is the $50M Series A of May 2025, reported as a minority investment.

funding_rounds.lead: co-led by Insight, Battery, Altimeter, Tiger

workato.note: Workato, enterprise automation, Mountain View. The firm's first investment dates from January 2021, the $110M Series D at $1.7B; the Series E of November 2021 was reported at $5.7B. | A/B pass (2026-09-26), entry round cited: the firm co-led the Series D of 2021-01: 'It was clear that Workato was filling a real market need, and we were excited to co-lead Workato's Series D financing in 2020.'

workit-health.note: Workit Health, virtual addiction treatment, Ann Arbor. The firm led the $118M Series C of October 2021.

workspan.note: WorkSpan, partner ecosystem management, Foster City. The firm led the Series B of 2019 and the $30M Series C of October 2022.

writer.note: Writer, enterprise generative AI, San Francisco. The firm led the $21M Series A of November 2021 and joined the Series B and C. Valued at $1.9B at the $200M Series C of November 2024; the web pass pins the mark. | A/B pass (2026-09-26): 'Writer has raised $200 million at a $1.9 billion valuation to expand its enterprise-focused generative AI platform.' (Series C ($200M, co-led by Premji Invest, Radical Ventures and ICONIQ Growth), 2024-11-12). | A/B pass (2026-09-27), entry round cited: the firm led the Series A: 'participation from WndrCo, Balderton Capital and Insight Partners, who led the Series A' (the firm's post on the Series B); 'Insight Partners led a $21 million Series A investment in WRITER in November 2021' (the firm's post of 2023-10).

xamarin.note: Xamarin, cross-platform mobile development, San Francisco. The firm led the $54M Series C of August 2014. Acquired by Microsoft in 2016.

xchange-formerly-exchange-applications-i.note: Xchange (formerly Exchange Applications), marketing automation software, Boston. The round of the firm's investment is not on record. IPO 1998; the company failed in 2002.

xelix.note: Xelix, accounts payable control software, London. 'Xelix secures $160 million Series B' (the firm's post, 2025-07-21), the round the firm led.

xelus.note: Xelus, service parts planning software, Fairport NY. The firm's first investment dates from October 1998; the round is not named on record. Acquired by Click Commerce in 2005.

xendit.note: Xendit, payments infrastructure for Southeast Asia, Jakarta. The firm co-led the $300M Series D of May 2022 with Coatue. | A/B pass (2026-09-26), entry round cited: the firm co-led the Series D of 2022-05: 'has raised a $300 million Series D led by New York-based growth equity investors Coatue and Insight Partners.'

xoip.note: XOIP, unified messaging portal, Amsterdam (the firm's list of 2000). The round of the firm's investment is not on record and the company's later state could not be established.

y42-fka-datos-intelligence.note: Y42 (formerly Datos Intelligence), data pipeline platform, Berlin. The firm led the $31M Series A of October 2021. | Momentum slice (2026-09-26): press search of the company beside the firm returned no funding report; no priced round at $1B or more is on record.

yext.note: Yext, digital presence management, New York (NYSE: YEXT, IPO 2017). The firm led the $50M round of June 2014 (the firm's post), the company's Series F. | A/B pass: market cap $640.4M on 2026-09-25 (stockanalysis.com)

yogome.note: Yogome, game-based learning apps for children, Mexico and the United States (the firm's 2018 page). It shut down in October 2018 after its founder was accused of inflating usage (https://www.edsurge.com/news/2018-10-24-months-after-raising-27m-education-startup-yogome-shuts-down-amid-fraud-allegations). The round of the firm's investment is not on record.

yoobic.note: YOOBIC, frontline employee platform for retailers, London. The firm led the $25M round of 2018 (the firm's post), the company's Series B.

yoom-fka-tetavi.note: Yoom (formerly Tetavi), volumetric video capture, Ramat Gan. 'Tetavi Closes Venture $20 M Round with Insight Partners' (the firm's post, 2021-08-10), a round after the company's Series A; its name is not on record. The company's later state could not be established.

funding_rounds.lead: Insight Partners, B Capital Group, Dragoneer

yubi-fka-credavenue.note: Yubi (formerly CredAvenue), debt marketplace for companies, Chennai. The firm co-led the $135M Series B of March 2022, reported at $1.3B. | A/B pass (2026-09-26): 'Following the secondary transaction, Yubi’s valuation stands at around $1.5 billion while Vivitry’s stakes have gone under 50%, according to an ET report.' (Secondary transaction (investors bought shares from the parent, Vivriti Capital), 2023-07). From a secondary sale, reported second-hand; the Series B of March 2022 was reported at $1.3B. No later priced round was found; the mark is older than 24 months. | A/B pass (2026-09-27), entry round cited: the firm co-led the Series B of 2022-03: 'The two-year-old startup has raised a $137 million Series B financing round led by Insight Partners, B Capital Group and Dragoneer' (TechCrunch).

zaius.note: Zaius, customer data platform for marketers, Boston. The firm led the $30M round of 2018 (the firm's post), the company's Series B. Acquired by Optimizely in 2021.

zenefits.note: Zenefits, HR and benefits software for small businesses, San Francisco. The firm joined the $500M Series C of May 2015 at $4.5B. Acquired by TriNet in February 2022.

zengo.note: ZenGo, self-custodial crypto wallet, Tel Aviv. 'ZenGo Closes $20M Series A Round' (the firm's post, 2021-04-27), the round the firm led. Acquired by eToro in April 2026.

zest-ai.note: Zest AI, machine-learning credit underwriting, Burbank. 'Zest AI Secures Investment From Insight Partners' (the firm's post, 2020-10-20), an unnamed growth round in a company founded in 2009; the firm put in a further $200M in December 2024.

zone-company.note: Zone & Co, billing and finance applications for NetSuite, Boston. 'Zone & Co Closes $76M Growth Equity Investment with Insight Partners' (the firm's post, 2021-10-14).

zumba-fitness.note: Zumba Fitness, dance-fitness brand, Hallandale Beach FL. Insight and The Raine Group invested in 2012, the company's first outside capital eleven years after its founding; the round carries no name.

zuva.note: Zuva, contracts AI spun out of Kira Systems in 2021, Toronto. The firm's post: 'Zuva Secures $20 million Series A Led by Insight Partners' (2021-09-29). | Momentum slice (2026-09-26): press search of the company found no later priced round; the newest funding report is the firm's own 'Zuva Secures $20 million Series A Led by Insight Partners' (2021-09-29); no priced round at $1B or more.
